lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: This thing just won't quit!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: If anything, it's only getting faster!

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: There must be an issue with the combat settings! It has to be shut down manually by the pilot!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: But Lily is unconscious!

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Ugh... My head...

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: What the... What are you guys doing?! Why are you attacking Providence?!

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: It's the other way around!

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Wait... why is this...?!

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Gah! H-hold on, I'll take care of it!

lines.speaker: ce006_03_op
lines.text: Why is it doing this?!
*Kuuuuu*
Finally, Providence stops moving, accompanied by the sound of the system shutting down.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: That was close.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: I don't get it. I set Raptures as the target. What happened?

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: I didn't input any other settings. It's only supposed to check for the energy source's wavelength...

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01_op
lines.text: What are you doing? Hurry up and come out.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Oh, right. I'll be right out.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Oh well. I must have made a mistake somewhere.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: I'm just glad no one got hurt. That was too close for comfort.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Well... now that we've resolved that minor hiccup,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: let's head back to the Ark.
Yeah, let's go.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: The Tetrapod is ready. We can leave right away.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Let's hurry.
Inside the Tetrapod.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Wow, this thing really can fly!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Can't you at least draw me some blueprints? I really want it.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: I tried to pull up the blueprints several times, but they kept coming out garbled and incomprehensible. I think it's time we throw in the towel.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Aw man... I can't stop thinking about it.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Trust me, me neither.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Adam. How much time until we arrive at our destination?

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: At our current speed, 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: We don't have to worry about anyone from the Ark intercepting us, do we?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: That won't happen. I've already contacted them.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I also told them the Commander is seriously injured, and to have a medical team on standby when we arrive.
What? But I'm fine.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If we told them we had Hermin in tow, medical treatment wouldn't be a priority for them.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: However, if a medical team is already on standby when we arrive, we can at least try and push for them to treat him.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Wow, you really are trying to become unemployed, aren't you?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Well, if that happens, why don't the Counters take me in?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm not sure a government desk jockey would be able to hack it with us.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Hmph.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: This is my first time going to the Ark.
We'll show you around once we're there.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: I'm excited.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: The Ark...

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Hermin, things might be chaotic when we first arrive.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: But it won't be permanent. Don't stress too much about it.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: I'm grateful that I'm here in the first place.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: Honestly, just knowing that all the data in the bunker was preserved is enough for me. I could die happy now.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Don't kid around about that. It doesn't come off like you're joking.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I'll be more careful with my words.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Uh oh.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: We've got company.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Raptures?

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: A whole bunch of 'em, closing in on us fast.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: That's okay. I'm sure you've got some kind of ultimate weapon in this ship.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: I wouldn't call it an ultimate weapon, but we do have some armaments.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Really?! Then let's fire away!

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: It won't be enough to wipe them all out.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Damn, this isn't good.
Adam stares at Hermin intently.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Rapi. How long will it take to get to the Ark on foot from here?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... About 2 hours.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Adam...

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Let me guess:

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: We stay here and hold them off while our friends go on ahead?

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Bingo.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Don't feel bad, you guys.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: A certain someone I know would have insisted we stay behind anyway. I'm just beating her to the punch.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: ... Hehe.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Landing.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Get going. Leave the rest to us.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Thank you.
We'll come back for you the first chance we get.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Sounds good. We'll be waiting.
Ark. Elevator Hub.
The elevator door opens,
revealing a small crowd of people.
Several humans in military uniforms, and a medical team stand before us.
An initial look of shock registers in the eyes of those in uniform, which then quickly turns into anger.
Privaty steps forward assertively.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I am Privaty of the Triangle Squad!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Move this civilian to the medical facility immediately!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: His physical condition is significantly weakened. I want you to use every means available to you to ensure his recovery.
One of the military men motions as if to start speaking, a fierce expression on his face.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I will not tolerate any insubordination!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Furthermore,

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: in my capacity as a member of the Central Government's defense force,

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I will take full responsibility for what follows.
In addition, this decision has been approved in coordination with the Special Commando Unit, Counters.
If you have any objections, you must present the relevant documentation, signed by a military officer of Deputy Chief rank or higher.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Have you all got cotton in your ears?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: What are you standing there for? Hurry up and move!
Meanwhile. Surface.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: How many more?

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: About fifteen!

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Time to wrap this up.
EVE runs off.
She closes the distance between her and the Raptures in an instant, piercing one of their cores with her blade,
sending a wave of energy from her blade which cleaves the ground in two.
Meanwhile, she dodges the incoming Rapture attack, accompanied by a flash of blue as she swings her sword all around, sending waves of energy in all directions.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Wow, she swings that sword like a fish swims through water. So natural, so free.
EVE deftly maneuvers her way around the Raptures as if performing a dance.
As she does this,
she feels something strange.
Golden particles begin to emanate not only from her body,
but also Adam, Lily, and even the Tetrapod.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Huh? What is this?

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: I'm not sure, but I have the sense it's time for us to head back.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: How do you know?

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Not sure. Just a feeling.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: But I thought we were supposed to defeat that Gatekeeper thing?

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: Maybe someone else took care of it, or the Gatekeeper likes to change its mind.
EVE continues to swing her sword around.
The golden particles intensify.
EVE realizes instinctively that everyone, including her, will disappear.
After slicing the last Rapture core in half, she stands still and catches her breath.

lines.speaker: ce006_npc_01
lines.text: EVE. It's time to go back.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Yeah. Seems like it.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: It would have been nice to see their faces one last time.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: We'll carry memories of them, and they'll carry memories of us.
EVE silently gazes in the direction where the Nikkes headed.
A gray sky. A desolate land.
Buildings that crumbled long ago.
An unwelcoming, and yet tragically familiar landscape.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Stay strong, all of you.
The golden particles continue to intensify.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: May our memories live on.
The golden particles scatter.
In their place, nothing remains.
The vast collection of the artwork data from the bunker was safely delivered to the Ark.
The invaluable materials contained within the data soon spread across the Ark,
and led to a surge in lectures, performances, and exhibitions on the artwork of the past human civilization.
News and media outlets ceaselessly ran stories on them.
The Ark overflowed with discussions about the art from times past.
Privaty was never punished nor reprimanded.
Under the condition that Hermin's identity and backstory remain undisclosed, she was granted a reprieve, despite her disobeying orders.
Hermin also did not wish for his identity to be revealed.
He said he only sought to preserve the data contained within the bunker, and how having accomplished that was more than enough.
Roam was appointed as an honorary member of the Counters, and was scheduled to be sent back up to the surface after undergoing repairs.
Now that Roam had seen the original Ark, it better knew what direction to take with the second Ark.
With Reclamation Site 01 as a foundation, it threw itself into constructing the second Ark.
No news has been heard about EVE or the others.
When we returned to the place where we parted, there was nothing left except for the wreckage of some fallen Raptures.
All the D-Wave signals had disappeared as well.
It was unfortunate that we couldn't say a proper goodbye.
... May our memories of them live on.
And...

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: I'm eternally grateful to you.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: Thanks to you all, my life... our lives have meaning.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: I believe that life itself can be art.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: By expressing oneself, by having an influence on others,

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: you are creating art every waking moment of your life, simply by living.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: May your lives, in all their artistic splendor,

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: continue on, and be passed down to future generations.
A week after arriving at the Ark,
Hermin passed away peacefully while holding onto the picture frames he cherished.
We stand in front of Hermin's memorial.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: They say it was a miracle that he lasted this long.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: He was in an extremely frail state when he arrived.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: There was nothing that could be done.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Still, you were able to show him around quite a bit, weren't you?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: ... Yes. I wanted to show him all that the Ark has to offer.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Even though I wasn't able to show him as much as I would have liked,

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: he was so happy.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: He loved seeing the traces of art that have remained throughout the Ark.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Big and small, the marks left behind by those from the bunker are still there.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Yes. He would tell me whose masterpiece this was inspired by, or whose failed work was improved upon beautifully.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I can't say that I understood all of it, but he certainly was very proud.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I wanted to show him more.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I wanted to tell him that what he fought for wasn't in vain.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: That because of them, the Ark was able to become a more beautiful place.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: That all that time they spent waiting was not wasted. Not in the slightest.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I wanted to tell him... to be proud.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: He knows all of that.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yeah. I'm sure he does.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I hope so.
Me too.
We place our hands on Hermin's memorial in silence.
To the one who dedicated his life to ensuring the past carries on into the present,
may he finally rest in peace.
And...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: May your memory live on.
MEMORIES: Continued
